supporting_observations.claim: The alerted host recorded a network logon for ken.ito from WS-KITO-01 at 13:42:52, followed by a special-privileges event for that account.

At 13:45:02, PowerShell ran as ken.ito with the command line for the inventory-approved Patch-Workstations.ps1 script on FILE-BLU-01; this matches the stated IT patching practice and scheduled business-hours patching.
The PowerShell process downloaded Windows Update content through the proxy, then launched wusa to install a Windows update package. This is consistent with the stated patching activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection are reported as available for WS-MSANTOS-01 during the reviewed window; no collection outage is listed for the alerted host.
The supplied process records show the PowerShell command line but not the script contents, execution output, or whether a visible window appeared.
The first PowerShell process in the supplied records is at 13:45:02, later than the reported approximate time of 13:40.
claims_not_established: The supplied evidence does not establish what the user saw at approximately 13:40 or whether the reported time was approximate.
The script path and command line are observed, but the contents and outcome of Patch-Workstations.ps1 are not established by these records.
